div.head: Af 77
div.ab: Gif mon oðrum ða geweald forslea up on ðam sweoran ⁊ forwundige to þam swiðe, þæt he nage ðæra geweald, ⁊ hwæðre libbe swa gescynded, gesylle him C scll' to bote, buton him witon mare gereccan ⁊ ryhtre.

Gif mon oðrum ða geweald forslea uppe on þam sweoran ⁊ forwundie to þam swiðe, þæt he nage þære geweald, ⁊ hwæðre lifie swa gescended, geselle him mon C scill. to bote, buton him witan ryhtre ⁊ mare gereccan.
Si quis in collo plagietur, ut inde perpetuam et insanabilem contrahat inualitudinem, et tamen uiuat ita contumeliatus, emendetur C solid., si non ei sapientum rectius et amplius iudicia destinabunt.

Gif mon oðrum ða geweald forslea uppe on þam sweoran ⁊ forwundie to þam swiðe, þæt he nage þære geweald, ⁊ hwæðre lifie swa gescended, geselle him mon C scill to bote, buton him witan ryhtre ⁊ mare gereccan.

If someone injures the power up on the neck, and wounds it so greatly, that he does not have power, and nonetheless lives thus afflicted, let him be paid 100 shillings as compensation, unless the witan adjudge more by law.

If one man damages the tendons in another's neck, and wounds him so severely that he has no control over them, but [if] he nevertheless continues to live so wounded, 100 shillings shall be given to him as compensation, unless the councillors award him a juster and a greater sum.

Wenn man einem anderen die ‘Gewalt’ [das Rückgrat?] zerschlägt oben am Nacken und [ihn] so sehr verwundet, dass er über sie keine Gewalt hat, und [wenn] er doch [weiter] lebt so verschändet, gebe man ihm 100 Schill. zur Busse, es sei denn dass die Richter ihm richtiger und mehr zusprechen.

If someone smashes another’s ‘control’ [the spine?] up at the neck and wounds [him] so badly that he has no control over it, and [if] he nevertheless lives [on] so disfigured, let him be given 100 shillings as compensation, unless the judges award him something more just and more.
